rubrics.justification: The response overstates image quality and assigns clearly visible features (well-developed blastocoel occupying most of embryo, distinct compact ICM, cohesive uniform TE, thinned zona) that are not convincingly identifiable in this image. It relies heavily on the provided 3AA label rather than the actual visual appearance.
It thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, cycle response, endometrium, infertility diagnosis, prior cycle history, BMI, and sperm parameters with embryo quality and prognosis.

The reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, with prognosis appropriately centered on maternal age-related aneuploidy despite good morphology. Minor issues include somewhat confident quantitative adjustments and mixing implantation/clinical pregnancy terminology.

Much of the advice is broadly guideline-consistent (SET, luteal support, vitrification), but recommendations such as routine low-dose aspirin, ERA, immunologic testing, growth hormone, and strong PGT-A endorsement are not uniformly supported by major guidelines for this scenario.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer, luteal support, testing timeline, cryopreservation, and contingency planning. It is useful clinically, though some suggested adjuncts/tests are more speculative than standard.
